steps.name: Enya
steps.text: This is...

steps.name: Young Huntress
steps.text: My home.

steps.name: Young Huntress
steps.text: Last I saw, they were going the opposite way. It's safe here. I'll wrap you up, and then you need to leave.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Thank you. I—

steps.name: Young Huntress
steps.text: Don't talk and don't fidget, Silverash.

steps.name: Young Huntress
steps.text: Your wounds aren't that bad. There was some distance, and your thick clothes absorbed some of the impact.

steps.name: Young Huntress
steps.text: But the bolt has a hooked head. It'll hurt when I pull it out. I'll try to be steady.
The young huntress snaps the arrow shaft and grabs the remaining part. She glances at the wounded woman, who simply nods, showing no sign of fear.
The huntress takes a deep breath and slowly pulls the arrow. Even she shivers at the sensation of the hook grating against flesh.
She does her best to keep her hands steady, until the arrowhead is completely pulled out.

steps.name: Young Huntress
steps.text: Phew—finally...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Thank you... very much...

steps.name: Young Huntress
steps.text: I'm not done yet. Hang in there a little longer.
She takes out a packet of powdered medicine, lifts the edge of Enya's dress, and rubs it skillfully on the wound before bandaging it up.

steps.name: Young Huntress
steps.text: You can yelp if it hurts. I won't laugh.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I don't want to make you more nervous.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: It'll only hurt more if your hands are shaking.

steps.name: Young Huntress
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Young Huntress
steps.text: ...Huh?
A slender, snow-white cloudbeast pokes its head out of the huntress's hood, hanging onto her braids with its claws and poking its wet nose around Enya's fur collar.
Then, it reaches out to sniff at the stranger's scent.

steps.name: Young Huntress
steps.text: Don't touch it. It doesn't like strangers.
Before the huntress can finish, Enya's finger has already reached the little cloudbeast's chin. Simply touching its soft fur seems to bring warmth to her heart, even in the bitter cold.

steps.name: Young Huntress
steps.text: (Whisper) Get back in, Rift Cloudbeast...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: You call it... the Rift Cloudbeast?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Come to think of it, I don't know your name yet, my hero.

steps.name: Young Huntress
steps.text: Joanna.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: I don't need to know your name, Silverash. Don't think for a moment that we're friends.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Why? You've been good to me.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: And how have you people treated me?!

steps.name: Young Huntress
steps.text: Hmph... forget it. Nothing to do with you, anyway.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: By 'you people', do you mean Clan Silverash?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Or Enciodes...?

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Not just him.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: My dad says the Silverashes have been obsessed with blaspheming Kjeragandr ever since Enciodes's father was clan leader.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: He poured asphalt on Kjeragandr's backbone, and poison on Kjeragandr's tail. His greed led to his downfall.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Enciodes hasn't learned his lesson. He's done even more to wreck Kjeragandr's peace.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: But his greatest sin was the hole he dug in Kjeragandr's flesh. This disaster is proof that Silverash has angered Kjeragandr.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: But Kjerag can't stay in the snowy mountains forever.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Haven't industry and trade brought us better lives? Why would the kind Kjeragandr punish us just because we're living better lives?

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Better lives?

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: You Silverashes sit by the warm fireside, eating the best food and drinking the best wine...

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: But who has to pay the price?

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Us, we do!

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Many beasts lived at the foot of the mountains when I was little.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: For a thousand years they lived off the land—drank from the rivers, and went back to the forest to find berries and leaves.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: But Karlan Trade's railroads divided the mountains and rivers, forcing the beasts to risk their lives crossing the railway.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: You even blame them when your trains run them over!

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: The beasts were forced to move higher, but there isn't enough room there for large packs. They had to fight each other for space and food, and their numbers dwindled.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Not to mention all the cloudbeasts that are sensitive to noise... you have no idea how many died, and how I ended up taking in my Rift Cloudbeast!

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: But the farmers by the mountains need the fertilizers and seeds that the trains bring. And sick people on the mountains need medicine.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Where's the bountiful game that Kjeragandr once gifted us, then?

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: The beasts grow fewer each year. Even water from the springs is less sweet.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: My family made a living hunting in the mountains for generations, following the holy teachings of Kjeragandr, and we show our faith by sculpting statues in Her image.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Dad... myself, and my siblings, we've always prayed to Kjeragandr, always paid our respects.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Why are WE the ones who have to pay the price?!
Spooked by the sudden outburst, the Rift Cloudbeast leaps down from a trembling Joanna and goes over to Enya.
Enya bends down and lifts it up, placing it back on Joanna's shoulder.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Don't move, or your wounds will reopen.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: This is the first time I've heard about any of that.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: If you want to argue, go ahead, Silverash.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: No, I don't.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I'm... different from the others. I have to stay at home most of the time, and what I know about the land today comes mostly from the accounts of others.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Sometimes I go out and experience things for myself, but it's not enough.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Kjeragandr will never abandon any children of Kjerag. I promise.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Hmph...

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: You better promise yourself that you pull through whatever's going on...

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: What was with those bandits, anyway? I know all the hunters living on the mountain. I didn't recognize any of those guys.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I think... they came for me.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: For you? Do you have enemies?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Hmm... It's a long story.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: If that's the case, you'd better stay put tonight. They won't give up so easily.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: My dad's friend has a shop in town, and my siblings have been helping out these past few days. I'll go get some medicine from him.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: And get help to fight the bandits.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: No, don't.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Why? Are you afraid to be on your own? I'm fast and strong. I can be back by tomorrow morning if I go down the mountain now.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: That's not what I'm worried about...

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Why? You Silverashes are such a bother. If you have something to say, just say it.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: If you can't fight, I have no choice but to get help from town. That's the deal.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Wait, I can tell you—
Enya hurriedly gets up, tugging at the sleeve of the huntress who is about to leave, causing her own cloak to fall off.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: The S-Saintess...?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Actually, I'm...

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: I-I'm sorry!

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Please, Your Holiness, punish me for my insolence!

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: No, I'm not going to punish you...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Please, just sit down...
Enya tries to stop the huntress, but she quickly takes a step back, putting more distance between herself and Enya.
She turns to leave, but then seems to remember something, and spins back around and bows reverentially to Enya, before finally leaving the room.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: General Gulo...

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Could you knock on the cheibe door before barging in, Matterhorn boy?

spans.text: door before barging in, Matterhorn boy?

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: What are you doing here?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: I was accompanying Lady Ensia for a checkup. She suffered a car accident this morning, but fortunately she's unharmed.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: I was told you were here too, so I thought I should pay a visit—are you alright?

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Hmph, just a scratch. But—

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Wait, you said something happened to the young Silverash lady?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Lady Ensia was delivering something to Sir Enciodes when she suffered a head-on collision with another vehicle on the way to the Vine-Bead Court. It was fortunate that Madam Degenbrecher quickly arrived on the scene.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: You said she was going to the Vine-Bead Court too?

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Strange. My master received a summons from the Vine-Bead Court this morning, saying there was a meeting, and it was on the way there that we were struck by falling rocks.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: ...Did you hear anything from the Browntails?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: No... not yet, at least. What's the matter with the Browntails?

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: No wonder Sir Arctosz was fuming when he left... I haven't seen him so angry in a long time.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: But this—argh!

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Listen, brother, I need you to do me a favor. Can you ask Sir Enciodes to go to the Browntail manor at once?

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Sir Arctosz is even more hot-headed than I am. I'm afraid he might do something impetuous. Sir Enciodes is the only one who can stop him.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: I see... I'll let him know immediately.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I suggest you get your head checked at the hospital, Arctosz. The symptoms of a mild concussion are easy to miss.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Don't try to change the subject!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Answer me! Why is it that only Clan Silverash and mine were attacked, while you Browntails sit safe and sound in your home? What do you know?!

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Everything that I know about what happened today came from you.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: More excuses!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Even the servants of Silverash knew to show concern, and tell me that Ensia suffered too.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: But what about you? You look like you couldn't care less, like it's nothing more than a piece of snow falling on the ground! Is this the Browntail stance?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I apologize for my demeanor. All of Kjerag has suffered in recent days. I ask for your understanding.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Enough of this hypocrisy.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: We both know there's been gossip going around about the Browntail Witch.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I never took it seriously. I couldn't care less what you did, as long as you did it for Kjerag and Kjeragandr.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: But now?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: When did Kjeragandr teach you to stab your allies in the back, Ratatos?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Watch your words, Arctosz. Do not disrespect Kjeragandr, even if you intend to insult and provoke me.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Stop dodging the question and answer!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Was Clan Browntail involved in the attack on me and Ensia?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: You're wasting your time. I've already told you multiple times: I know nothing about it, and I express my sympathies.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: If that's your final answer, then don't accuse me of going too far.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: What do you mean?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Don't think I'm out of Paleroches just because you took Gulo out of action. Before I went out, I told my men when to show.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Clan Browntail's estates will be thoroughly searched. I didn't want to go this far, but I'm afraid Sciurus and her children will have to bear with me a little.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: You dare?!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: You made me do this, Ratatos!
The door to the drawing room flies open without warning. Arctosz draws his sword immediately.
The sharp-eyed Browntail guards raise their weapons too and stand in front of Ratatos.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I take it you've already discussed the incidents that occurred today.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I came for the same reason, and I've reached certain conclusions. Please, stand down.
Seeing that Arctosz has sheathed his sword, Ratatos raises a hand, and her guards hesitantly back off.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Good timing, Enciodes.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: With the leaders of Clans Paleroche and Silverash both present, we demand a thorough audit of Clan Browntail's documents, and cooperation from Clan Browntail in the investigation.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Sorry, Arctosz, but I don't assent to the demand.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Why would Ratatos want to get rid of us?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Assassinating the heads of the other two clans at this moment would only cause even more chaos.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Clan Paleroche has the most warriors, while Clan Silverash runs Karlan Trade.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Ratatos could not hope to keep the situation under control if you and I both died in an accident. Meanwhile, retribution would be swift and harsh.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Am I right?
Ratatos avoids Enciodes's gaze and nods lightly.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: That doesn't explain why Clan Browntail wasn't attacked.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Maybe a coincidence, maybe bad timing. Maybe the attackers had something planned for the Browntails too, and we just don't know about it.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: You won't convince me with talk of coincidences, Enciodes.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Who would have done such a thing, if not Ratatos?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: This is not a question we can solve in a short time.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Don't forget that there are plenty of people looking to take advantage of the chaos, and take a piece of Kjerag for themselves.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: This assassination coincided with the arrival of Victorian aid. The mastermind wants to keep us from working together.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: The Victorians did this?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: They are potential suspects, as is any foreign politician who attempts to intervene at this juncture.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Therefore, I would like to maintain the status quo of our previous meeting—I will continue to handle all external affairs, including those involving Victoria.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I will discover the truth, for Clan Paleroche, for the peace of the three clans... and for Ensia.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I'll trust you one last time...

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Hmph...

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Don't you dare look smug, Ratatos. You got lucky today. You can thank Enciodes and Sciurus.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: If it turns out you're behind all this after all, you'll get what's coming to you!
The sturdy Ursus slams the table, then turns and leaves.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Thank you for calming that maniac down, Enciodes.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: But I'm exhausted. I'm sure you understand how tiring it is to deal with baseless accusations.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: If you suspect me and want to question me, I—

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: There's no need for that. Trust between the three clans has never been more important than now.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I have other urgent matters to attend to. I'll take my leave.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Pardon me for not seeing you out.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Ensia wasn't hurt. You can rest easy.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I was the one they were after.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Obviously. The accident was very likely staged. They targeted your car, without knowing who was inside.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Something's not right... it's too forward. It's as though the people behind this want to make the point that they have no qualms about deploying extreme measures.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: They're trying to sow chaos and suspicion. The act itself is more important than the result.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: There is another possibility... perhaps it's not me, Ensia, or Arctosz whom they're truly after.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: There will be trouble on the mountains.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: It's Enya they're after?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: If anything happens to the Saintess at this point, it will serve to affirm all the conspiracy theories, and drag Kjerag further into the quagmire.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I need you to protect Enya, Degenbrecher.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Enya set out a long time ago. I can't promise anything.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: You need to prepare for the worst.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I believe in Enya.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: You 'believe'.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: And you will not provide any of your basis for that belief to reassure me? Like you usually do?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Correct.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I believe.
